scope: Single-token synthetic LinearAttention through the installed native RyzenAI ORT provider, compared to completed direct-DD experiments

method.array_hash_encoding: C-order little-endian raw array bytes, without NumPy headers
method.native_session_scope: Each of the three experiments has one session construction, one execute, and zero retries
method.direct_session_scope: A separate prior direct-DD runtime was initialized once and executed twice, one call per synthetic state case
method.threshold: Exact equality of all output storage bits for the defined conversion, not a tolerance test
method.fp16_comparison: BF16 -> exact FP32 decoding -> FP16 rounding, then compare raw uint16 storage; 12 asymmetric state values change at the FP16 boundary
method.hypotheses: All 16 reference hypotheses per native case and all 16 per direct case are preserved; no alternative rows are discarded
method.timings: Single-call diagnostic timings include differing setup costs and are not a speed benchmark

limitations: The asymmetric state is synthetic and seeded, not the state produced by a real 128-token prefix. Host count 129 labels a test position only.
Zero state does not discriminate recurrent-state input orientation or decay semantics; the asymmetric case is the discriminating probe.
Passing model_type=9/input_num=6 with the seventh UINT32 host input is an observed experimental path, not an AMD-supported Qwen3.5 integration claim.
The supplied query fixture is already normalized/scaled; the reference query scale is exactly 1.0.
These isolated operations do not establish full-model correctness, multi-token state evolution, EOS, 16K context, or Token Fusion.
